title: FPGA-based Alice syndrome encoder reusing LDPC shifter and ROM

hardware_architecture_benefit.resource_reuse: Shares existing 128-lane barrel shifter with Bob decoder
hardware_architecture_benefit.bram_overhead: 0 BRAMs (distributed LUT RAM for temporary 24-column buffer)
hardware_architecture_benefit.throughput_mbit_s: Emits 128-bit layer syndrome in 24 clock cycles (~266 Mbit/s at 50 MHz)
